About

The formula with overnight efficacy combines high molecular Hyaluronic Acid, which binds moisture in the skin's surface, and low molecular Hyaluronic Acid, which penetrates deeper into the skin where wrinkles originate. In combination with Glycerin the formula offers very high skin hydration and increases moisture significantly. ProVitamin B5 actively regenerates and strengthens the skin overnight, while Vitamin E relieves the skin from oxidative stress.

This ultra-light and refreshing gel night care delivers immediate hydration, targets fine lines and first wrinkles, and actively regenerates skin overnight.

The formula combines two highly concentrated types of Hyaluronic Acid with Glycerin. These substances are also produced naturally by skin to keep itself moisturised and, as part of our formula, they work as moisture magnets plumping up skin with immediate and intensive moisture for up to 72h.

Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster Night care is clinically and dermatologically proven to deliver excellent results.

The Moisture Booster Night care is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Add to your nightly skincare routine for skin that looks fresh, healthy, less tired, and feels more resilient.

Clinical Formula

Hyaluronic acid

Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.

Learn More
Glycerin

Glycerin, also called glycerol, is a humectant, which means it helps attract water thereby trapping it in the skin. This makes it a very effective moisturiser, as it both smooths dry skin and gives it long-lasting protection and care. Glycerol is colourless, odourless and non-toxic.

FAQ

At what age should I start using Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster Night?

You can use the booster at any age. Genetics, lifestyle and environment all affect how and when our skin starts to age, but many of us experience the first signs of skin ageing in our 20s. Fine lines and wrinkles start to appear and skin can look dull and tired. Regular cleansing, moisturisation and sun protection will help you to keep your skin healthy and prevent premature skin ageing. 

Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Effect Moisture Booster Night is clinically and dermatologically proven to deliver immediate and long-lasting hydration and plump up skin, so it’s ideal if your skin is looking or feeling dehydrated.

For more information on the different stages of skin ageing, and to help you find the right products for you, read our article on skin at different ages.

Why do I need a night care product?

Skin regenerates overnight. As well as moisturising skin, night care products contain ingredients that stimulate the cell regeneration process. In Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster Night the ingredient ProVitamin B5 supports skin renewal overnight.

Is Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster Night suitable for sensitive skin?

Yes. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster Night is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It is clinically and dermatologically proven to be both effective on and well-tolerated by sensitive skin.

Can this product be used daily?

Yes. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster Night is designed to be used as part of your nightly skincare routine.

My skin looks or feels dehydrated. Will this product give it a moisture boost?

Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster Night gives skin an immediate and intense moisture boost and increases skin hydration for up to 72 hours overnight.
